segments.text:
V. 3.
To know—By loving, holy Faith, thee the only true God— The only Cauſe and End of all Things; not excluding the Son and the Holy Ghoſt, no more than the Father is excluded from being LORD, 1. Cor. viii. 6. but the falſe Gods of the Heathens, and Jeſus Chriſt—As their Prophet, Prieſt, and King: this is life eternal—It is both the Way to, and the Eſſence of everlaſting Happineſs.
